# rgdevment

> Free, open source desktop programs for Windows and macOS, built by Mario Hidalgo G. (rgdevment). No account, no telemetry, no server, no paid tier. Everything each one keeps stays on the user's own disk.

Motto: software out of conviction, not subscription.

## Tools

- [Tisty](https://www.tisty.app/): Notes, documents and tasks, and the record of what you learned solving them: what you finish keeps its steps, its dated journal and the documents you leaned on. Plain files on disk, readable without the application. Syncs between computers through the user's own Google Drive, OneDrive or WebDAV server, encrypted if they want with a 24-word phrase only they know, or through a folder they already sync, with no server in between. Exposes an MCP server so an assistant can read and write them with permission. Windows and macOS. AGPL-3.0.
- [LinkUnbound](https://www.linkunbound.app/): Chooses which browser opens every link. Registers as the default browser on Windows and macOS; a rule can match the site, a browser profile, or the application the link came from. Unwraps Microsoft SafeLinks. GPL-3.0-only.
- [CoPanda](https://www.copanda.app/): Formerly CopyPaste. Clipboard manager keeping a searchable local history. Ignores clipboard content from password managers. Windows and macOS. GPL-3.0.

## Documentation

Built from each project's GitHub wiki, in English and Spanish.

- [Tisty docs](https://www.tisty.app/docs/): installation, the Markdown editor, tasks, the archive, sync and backup, the MCP server and its tools.
- [Tisty Markdown](https://markdown.tisty.app/): every word a Tisty document understands, CommonMark and GitHub's additions plus Tisty's own, one page each ([summary](https://markdown.tisty.app/llms.txt), [full](https://markdown.tisty.app/llms-full.txt), [español](https://markdown.tisty.app/es/)).
- [LinkUnbound docs](https://www.linkunbound.app/docs/): installation, the picker, rules, browsers and profiles, links from other apps, troubleshooting.
- [CoPanda docs](https://www.copanda.app/docs/): installation, the panel, content kinds, paste as, backup and migration, troubleshooting.
- Each app's own summary for assistants, and all its docs in one file: [Tisty](https://www.tisty.app/llms.txt) ([full](https://www.tisty.app/llms-full.txt)), [LinkUnbound](https://www.linkunbound.app/llms.txt) ([full](https://www.linkunbound.app/llms-full.txt)), [CoPanda](https://www.copanda.app/llms.txt) ([full](https://www.copanda.app/llms-full.txt)).

## Pricing and support

- [Pricing](https://rgdevment.com/pricing/): Every program is free in full. No paid tier, no trial, no feature behind a wall, no account. Why there is no catch: no company, no investors, no payroll.
- [Support](https://rgdevment.com/support/): Ways to help that cost nothing (a star, a Store rating, naming it where somebody asks, reporting what breaks) and, after those, sponsoring.

## Guides

- [Notes you can read without the app](https://rgdevment.com/guides/notes-you-can-read-without-the-app/): How to find out what an export really gives you back, and why plain files avoid the question.
- [Let an assistant read your notes](https://rgdevment.com/guides/let-an-assistant-read-your-notes/): Using MCP so a model reads your notes where they are instead of uploading them.
- [Open Teams links in another browser](https://rgdevment.com/guides/open-teams-links-in-another-browser/): The setting Teams carries, what it does not fix, and routing per link.
- [Open Outlook links in Chrome or Firefox](https://rgdevment.com/guides/open-outlook-links-in-chrome-or-firefox/): The classic Outlook setting under File, Options, Advanced, and what it leaves out.
- [Send work links to a Chrome profile](https://rgdevment.com/guides/send-work-links-to-a-chrome-profile/): Why Chrome opens the wrong profile and how to route by profile.
- [A Browserosaurus alternative still maintained](https://rgdevment.com/guides/browserosaurus-alternative/): What happened to Browserosaurus and what the alternatives are on each platform.
- [Windows clipboard history](https://rgdevment.com/guides/windows-clipboard-history/): How to enable Win+V, and the limits of 25 entries, 4 MB and being wiped on restart.
- [Clipboard history on macOS](https://rgdevment.com/guides/clipboard-history-on-mac/): macOS keeps only the last item copied; what the Finder shows and what it does not.
